newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London dip in cautious trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London dip in cautious trade.

text.p: Hong Kong shares were slightly lower in thin trade on Friday, with most market participants on the sidelines ahead of Wall Street's opening, dealers said.
"It's been another quiet day. People don't want to do much in case Wall Street has another rough session," one dealer said.

The Hang Seng London Reference index was down 16.08 points at 13,206.71 by 1400 GMT. In Hong Kong on Friday, the Hang Seng index ended 19.35 points higher at 13,222.79 after seesawing within a 100-point range. Turnover was a heavy HK$11.09 billion, well up on Thursday's HK$10.09 billion.
